description: This file defines the DbSession class, a wrapper around Hibernate's Session to maintain backward compatibility across different Hibernate versions in the OpenMRS platform. It provides methods for transaction management, query creation, entity operations, session configuration, and more, facilitating interaction with the database via Hibernate in the OpenMRS system.

classes.name: DbSession
classes.description: A wrapper class around Hibernate's Session to support different Hibernate versions and facilitate database interactions within the OpenMRS platform.
